theorem actual_product_lt
    {N d a1 a2 a3 r : ℕ} {z w : ℝ}
    (ht : (a1, a2, a3) ∈ orderedTriples (primeWindow (d * N) z w))
    (hr : r ∈ roughNumbers
      ((N : ℝ) / ((d * a1 * a2 * a3 : ℕ) : ℝ)) (a2 : ℝ)) :
    d * a1 * a2 * a3 * r < N
public_hypotheses: ht: actual strict ordered triple membership in primeWindow(d*N,z,w)
proof_route: Extract a1 prime and coprime(d*N) from first coordinate membership, then coprime N
D=d*a1*a2*a3: D=0 gives local non-strict upper bound by simp; D≠0 calls the existing nonunit_gate_iff with locally derived positivity
a1 divides the complete original product by the existing natural multiplication structure
Non-strict bound plus inequality gives strict bound via omega
unit_case: No r≠1 assumption or unit split; all original unit labels remain. Existing one_mem_roughNumbers gives its exact size gate.
repeated_tail_factors: No squarefree/primality/distinctness assumption on r; every repeated factor allowed by original roughNumbers remains.
N_zero_boundary: The theorem has no hN premise. At N=0 primeWindow(d*N,...) contains no prime coprime0; membership is impossible. The proof uses the same coprime-divisibility contradiction rather than adding a positivity gate.
d_zero_boundary: No hd premise. For d=0 original primeWindow mask is0, so triple membership is already impossible; independently positive roughNumbers membership at N/0 is impossible. The proof still covers D=0 locally.
scale_and_label_preservation: Original physical natural N, parent d, all three ordered labels and original middle cutoff a2 remain unchanged. No new carrier/filter or receiver test introduced.
